profile.headline: Software Engineer at Broadcom
profile.summary:
System software engineering from bios level to middle wares.
Recently working on Fiber Channel switch system including FABOS and FC ASIC drivers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineering of Fiber Channel switch systems
FABOS, FC switch device driver, Embedded platforms development for OEM

positions.title: Staff SW Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop the embedded fiber switch systems on the Linux platform.
Development of Diagnostic Software for the Brocade switching systems using u-boot.

positions.title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement the firmware of HDBaseT IO Card in Linx video switching system. Drivers for HDMI/HDCP.

positions.title: Staff Embedded SW Engineer
positions.description: Linux device driver and porting layer for PowerTV for Time Warner  DVR STB. Specially works as HDMI/HDCP expert for triaging Time Warner customer issues.

positions.title: Staff System Software Engineer
positions.description: Staff System software engineering - Surveillance System Software

positions.title: System Software Engineer
positions.description: FTTC VDSL Set-Top-Box, ATM Network IC Control, VOD Server, KT-VOD Trial, VMS
